description.name: Entry
description.text: Activates Water Chain (max 150, field +50%) or adds +25 to the current chain limit, inflicts [Imperil Water 10% (5s)]/[Imperil Water 20% (5s)]/[Imperil Water 30% (5s)] to all enemies with 0-1/2-3/4 allies with [Attach Water], grants [ATK +50%] to all allies & [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%
